Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the mandatory retirement provision for district judges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying the mandatory retirement provision fordistrict judges; and amending RCW 3.74.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 3.74.030 and 1984 c 258 s 56 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A district judge shall retire from judicial office at the ((end ofthe calendar year)) expiration of the judge's term of office in whichhe or she has attained the age of seventyfive years. This provisionshall not affect the term to which any such judge shall have beenelected or appointed prior to August 11, 1969.
